quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Every Tuesday, Wei goes for a check-up at the dentist. The dentist cleans his teeth and checks for any problems. Wei always brushes carefully so the visit goes smoothly.
options: A Dentist Who Visits Wei's House
Brushing Teeth Only Before the Visit
A Regular Dental Check-up Routine
A Dentist Who Found Many Problems
quests.correctAnswer: A Regular Dental Check-up Routine
quests.hint: Ask yourself how often Wei visits and what he does to make each check-up go smoothly.
quests.explanation: This paragraph is about a recurring health routine. The regular check-ups themselves belong in the summary, not just the detail about brushing beforehand.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Every Saturday afternoon, Noah plays board games with his neighbors. They take turns choosing the game and keep score on paper. Noah says it is the best part of his week.
options: A Favorite Weekend Tradition with Neighbors
Keeping Score Without Playing Any Games
Choosing a New Neighbor Each Week
A Game Night Noah Dislikes
quests.correctAnswer: A Favorite Weekend Tradition with Neighbors
quests.hint: Consider what Noah looks forward to each Saturday and who joins him for it.
quests.explanation: The paragraph centers on a favorite recurring activity with neighbors. Naming both the tradition and the people involved captures it better than focusing on the scorekeeping.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A poster at the gym said, 'Wipe Down Equipment After Use.' Most members followed the rule and used the cleaning spray. The gym stayed clean and tidy all day.
options: Members Who Ignored the Cleaning Rule
A Poster About Gym Membership Prices
A Gym That Stayed Messy All Day
A Gym Rule That Keeps Equipment Clean
quests.correctAnswer: A Gym Rule That Keeps Equipment Clean
quests.hint: Look at what the poster asked members to do and how the gym looked afterward.
quests.explanation: A posted rule and its positive result form the two connected halves of this paragraph. Linking the instruction to the clean outcome it produced gives the fuller picture.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Ana feeds her cat at the same time every morning and evening. The cat waits by its bowl a few minutes before each meal. This routine keeps the cat healthy and happy.
options: A Cat That Refuses to Eat
Feeding the Cat Only Once a Week
A Daily Feeding Routine for a Healthy Cat
A Cat That Feeds Itself
quests.correctAnswer: A Daily Feeding Routine for a Healthy Cat
quests.hint: Notice when Ana feeds her cat and why keeping that schedule matters.
quests.explanation: This paragraph connects a consistent care routine to the cat's well-being. The strongest summary links the schedule with that benefit rather than describing just one meal.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: In art class, students painted pictures of their favorite season. Some chose snowy winters, while others painted sunny summer beaches. The teacher displayed every painting on the classroom wall.
options: Students Paint Their Favorite Seasons in Art Class
A Teacher Who Painted All the Pictures
Students Who Only Painted Winter Scenes
Paintings That Were Never Displayed
quests.correctAnswer: Students Paint Their Favorite Seasons in Art Class
quests.hint: Think about the assignment students completed and what happened to their finished work.
quests.explanation: The activity and how the results were displayed both belong in the summary, along with the variety of seasons students chose to paint.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Marcus drives a delivery truck around the city. He delivers packages to homes and offices every day. He enjoys meeting new people at each stop along his route.
options: A Driver Who Delivers Only on Weekends
A Delivery Driver Who Enjoys Meeting People
Packages Delivered to One Address Only
A Driver Who Avoids Talking to People
quests.correctAnswer: A Delivery Driver Who Enjoys Meeting People
quests.hint: Ask yourself what Marcus's job involves and what he enjoys most about it.
quests.explanation: This paragraph covers both Marcus's daily work and his attitude toward it, so a complete summary combines the job with what makes it enjoyable for him.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Before her trip to Italy, Sofia studied a few common phrases in Italian. At the airport, she practiced saying 'thank you' to the staff. They smiled and helped her find her gate.
options: Staff Who Refused to Help Sofia
Sofia Speaking Only English at the Airport
A Trip to Italy That Was Canceled
Practicing New Phrases Before a Trip to Italy
quests.correctAnswer: Practicing New Phrases Before a Trip to Italy
quests.hint: Notice what Sofia practiced before her trip and how it helped once she arrived.
quests.explanation: Preparation and payoff are linked here: Sofia's phrase practice led directly to a smoother airport experience, and a good summary reflects that whole sequence.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The Walsh cousins build a treehouse together every summer at their grandparents' farm. Each year, they add something new, like a rope ladder or a small window. The treehouse keeps getting better.
options: Cousins Building a Treehouse Together Every Summer
A Treehouse Built in a Single Afternoon
Cousins Who Visit the Farm Only Once
A Treehouse That Never Changes
quests.correctAnswer: Cousins Building a Treehouse Together Every Summer
quests.hint: Consider how often the cousins work on the treehouse and what changes about it each year.
quests.explanation: Because this is an ongoing project that keeps improving, the summary should capture both the teamwork and the gradual progress, not just one year's addition.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Diego compared prices at three different stores before buying a new backpack. He found the same backpack for ten dollars less at the last store. He felt proud of his smart shopping.
options: Buying a Backpack at the First Store
Paying Extra for a Popular Brand
Comparing Prices to Find the Best Deal
A Backpack That Cost the Same Everywhere
quests.correctAnswer: Comparing Prices to Find the Best Deal
quests.hint: Look at what Diego did before buying the backpack and what he gained by doing it.
quests.explanation: The process of comparing prices and the money it saved are directly connected. Reflecting both the action and its benefit works better than mentioning just the final price.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Aunt Rosa teaches a cooking class twice a month at the community center. She shows neighbors how to make simple, healthy meals on a budget. Many students now cook more often at home.
options: A Class That Meets Every Single Day
A Cooking Class That Teaches Budget-Friendly Meals
Students Who Stopped Cooking at Home
A Class About Expensive Restaurant Food
quests.correctAnswer: A Cooking Class That Teaches Budget-Friendly Meals
quests.hint: Look at what Aunt Rosa's class focuses on and how it has changed her students' habits.
quests.explanation: This paragraph explains both the class's focus and its effect on students. Mentioning the lessons together with the resulting change in behavior makes the summary complete.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Grandma video calls her grandchildren every weekend using a tablet. At first, she found the buttons confusing, but her granddaughter taught her step by step. Now she calls without any help.
options: Grandma Learning to Video Call Her Family
A Granddaughter Who Refused to Help
Grandma Calling Only Once a Year
A Tablet That Grandma Never Learned to Use
quests.correctAnswer: Grandma Learning to Video Call Her Family
quests.hint: Pay attention to how Grandma's comfort with the tablet changes from the start of the paragraph to the end.
quests.explanation: This paragraph tracks a full learning journey from confusion to confidence. Reflecting that whole process works better than mentioning only the weekend calls.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: After hurting his knee, Felix started seeing a physical therapist twice a week. The therapist gave him exercises to do at home as well. After two months, Felix could walk without any pain.
options: Exercises That Made the Knee Worse
A Therapist Felix Saw Only Once
Recovering from a Knee Injury Through Therapy
Felix Walking with Pain After Two Months
quests.correctAnswer: Recovering from a Knee Injury Through Therapy
quests.hint: Follow Felix's knee injury from the first therapy visit through to the final result.
quests.explanation: This paragraph follows a path from injury to recovery. Connecting the therapy sessions with the positive outcome they produced is what makes the summary accurate.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The community theater is putting on a play next month. Local actors of all ages are rehearsing three nights a week. Tickets are already selling quickly for opening night.
options: A Play Performed by Professional Actors Only
A Community Play Drawing Excited Ticket Buyers
Rehearsals Happening Just Once a Month
Tickets That Are Not Selling Well
quests.correctAnswer: A Community Play Drawing Excited Ticket Buyers
quests.hint: Picture who is involved in the play and how the public is responding to it.
quests.explanation: Preparation for the play and the strong ticket demand are two connected ideas here, so the strongest summary brings them together.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: An email from the school said classes would start one hour later on Monday. Parents read the message and planned new morning schedules. Most families adjusted without any trouble.
options: A Message About Canceling School Entirely
Parents Who Ignored the New Schedule
Classes Starting One Hour Earlier
An Email Announcing a Later School Start Time
quests.correctAnswer: An Email Announcing a Later School Start Time
quests.hint: Notice what the email announced and how families reacted to the change.
quests.explanation: The announcement and the families' adjustment are both part of this paragraph. A complete summary reflects the message's content along with its effect.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Sam sorts his recycling into paper, plastic, and glass bins every weekend. His neighbors noticed and started doing the same thing. Now the whole street recycles much more than before.
options: Sam Who Recycles Only Paper
Neighbors Who Refused to Recycle
A Recycling Habit That Spread Through the Neighborhood
A Habit Sam Started Just Last Week
quests.correctAnswer: A Recycling Habit That Spread Through the Neighborhood
quests.hint: Consider Sam's habit and how it spread to the people living around him.
quests.explanation: One person's routine spreading to an entire street is the real focus here. Capturing that wider effect matters more than listing the sorting steps.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The school added a new garden club this year. Students plant vegetables and learn how long each one takes to grow. At the end of the season, they share the vegetables with the cafeteria.
options: A Club That Only Studies Pictures of Plants
Vegetables That Are Thrown Away Each Season
A Garden Club Open to Teachers Only
A New Garden Club Growing Food for the Cafeteria
quests.correctAnswer: A New Garden Club Growing Food for the Cafeteria
quests.hint: Pay attention to what the club does with the vegetables once they are fully grown.
quests.explanation: The gardening activity and its connection to the cafeteria are both essential. Including where the food ends up matters just as much as the planting itself.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Janet recently switched careers from accounting to graphic design. She took evening classes for a year while keeping her old job. Now she designs logos for small businesses full time.
options: A Career Change from Accounting to Design
Janet Quitting Her Job Before Taking Classes
Janet Designing Logos as a Hobby Only
A Career Change That Took One Week
quests.correctAnswer: A Career Change from Accounting to Design
quests.hint: Trace Janet's path from her old job through her evening classes to her new career.
quests.explanation: This paragraph follows a complete career transition. Reflecting the full change, from the old job to the new one, works better than naming just a single stage.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The hiking trail was closed for repairs, so Theo chose a different path up the mountain. The new path was longer but had a beautiful waterfall. Theo was glad he changed his plan.
options: A Trail That Stayed Open the Whole Time
A Detour That Led to a Beautiful Waterfall
Theo Turning Back Without Hiking
A Waterfall on the Original Trail
quests.correctAnswer: A Detour That Led to a Beautiful Waterfall
quests.hint: Consider why Theo had to change his path and what he found because of it.
quests.explanation: An unexpected change of plans leading to a pleasant surprise is the core idea. Linking the detour with the waterfall Theo discovered captures that idea best.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Grandpa is teaching his grandson how to fix old clocks. They sit together in the garage every Wednesday afternoon. The grandson now knows how to repair simple clock parts on his own.
options: A Grandfather Teaching His Grandson Clock Repair
A Grandson Who Already Knew Clock Repair
Lessons That Happen Only Once a Year
A Grandfather Who Repairs Clocks Alone
quests.correctAnswer: A Grandfather Teaching His Grandson Clock Repair
quests.hint: Notice who is teaching, who is learning, and what new skill is being built.
quests.explanation: A regular lesson and the grandson's growing skill are both part of this paragraph. Mentioning the teaching relationship together with its result gives the fuller picture.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: During the holiday sale, the mall was full of shoppers carrying bags. Lily waited until the last hour to avoid the biggest crowds. She still found great discounts on winter coats.
options: A Mall That Was Completely Empty
Lily Shopping Early in the Morning
Coats That Were Not on Sale
Avoiding Crowds While Still Finding Holiday Discounts
quests.correctAnswer: Avoiding Crowds While Still Finding Holiday Discounts
quests.hint: Ask yourself whether Lily's shopping strategy actually worked out for her.
quests.explanation: Lily's timing and her successful result are directly connected. Linking her plan to avoid crowds with the discounts she still found is what makes the summary complete.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The new food truck downtown sells tacos made from family recipes. Long lines form every lunchtime near the office buildings. Workers say the tacos are worth the short wait.
options: A Food Truck with No Customers
Tacos Sold Only on Weekends
A Popular Food Truck Serving Family-Recipe Tacos
Workers Who Avoid the Food Truck
quests.correctAnswer: A Popular Food Truck Serving Family-Recipe Tacos
quests.hint: Think about what makes this food truck special and how popular it has become.
quests.explanation: The truck's specialty and its lunchtime popularity work together here, so a complete summary combines both ideas rather than focusing on just one.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The city installed free charging stations for electric bikes near the train station. Commuters now charge their bikes while they shop or have lunch. Bike use in the area has increased noticeably.
options: Charging Stations That Cost a Lot of Money
Free Bike Charging Stations Boosting Bike Use
Bike Use That Dropped After Installation
Stations Located Far from the Train Station
quests.correctAnswer: Free Bike Charging Stations Boosting Bike Use
quests.hint: Compare what the city installed with what changed about bike use afterward.
quests.explanation: The new charging stations and the rise in bike use are cause and effect here. Connecting the installation with what it led to captures the paragraph's point.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The clinic now offers free flu shots every October. Nurses set up a table in the lobby so patients do not need an appointment. Hundreds of people got their shot last year.
options: Flu Shots That Require a Long Appointment
A Clinic That Charges High Prices
A Clinic Offering Free, Easy Flu Shots
Shots Offered Only to Clinic Staff
quests.correctAnswer: A Clinic Offering Free, Easy Flu Shots
quests.hint: Consider what makes getting a flu shot at this clinic simple for patients.
quests.explanation: Both the free cost and the easy, appointment-free access matter here. Together they show how convenient the whole program is, which is the real point of the paragraph.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A local artist painted a colorful mural on the side of the old bookstore. People now stop to take photos in front of it every day. The bookstore says more customers come in because of it.
options: A Mural Painted Inside the Bookstore
A Mural That No One Notices
A Bookstore That Lost Customers After the Mural
A Mural That Brings New Customers to a Bookstore
quests.correctAnswer: A Mural That Brings New Customers to a Bookstore
quests.hint: Think about what the mural has done for foot traffic at the bookstore.
quests.explanation: The artwork and its effect on business are directly linked. Reflecting both the mural and the new customers it brings in makes for the strongest summary.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A text message from the dentist reminded Carmen about her appointment on Thursday. It also asked her to arrive fifteen minutes early for paperwork. Carmen set a reminder on her phone right away.
options: A Text Reminder About a Dentist Appointment
A Text Canceling Carmen's Appointment
A Reminder to Arrive One Hour Early
Carmen Forgetting to Set a Reminder
quests.correctAnswer: A Text Reminder About a Dentist Appointment
quests.hint: Notice what the text message said and how quickly Carmen responded to it.
quests.explanation: The message's content and Carmen's quick response both matter here. Reflecting the reminder's purpose works better than focusing on a smaller detail like the arrival time.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Every Wednesday, Tariq does a deep clean of his apartment. He vacuums, washes dishes, and changes his bed sheets. He says starting each week in a clean space helps him feel calm.
options: Tariq Cleaning Only Once a Month
A Weekly Cleaning Routine That Brings Calm
Washing Dishes but Never Vacuuming
A Messy Apartment That Tariq Enjoys
quests.correctAnswer: A Weekly Cleaning Routine That Brings Calm
quests.hint: Notice when Tariq cleans and how it affects the way he feels afterward.
quests.explanation: The weekly cleaning habit and Tariq's sense of calm are directly linked. Connecting the routine with that emotional benefit is what the summary needs to capture.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The school debate club meets every Thursday after class. Students research both sides of a topic before arguing their assigned position. Many students say the club has improved their public speaking.
options: A Club That Meets Only Once a Year
Students Who Argue Without Any Research
A Club Focused on Writing, Not Speaking
A Debate Club That Improves Public Speaking
quests.correctAnswer: A Debate Club That Improves Public Speaking
quests.hint: Consider what students do in the club and the skill it helps them build over time.
quests.explanation: The club's activities and the skill students gain both matter here. Connecting the practice of debating with the resulting improvement gives the complete picture.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Hannah recently became the youngest manager at her company. She leads a team of ten people and plans weekly project goals. Her coworkers say she listens carefully before making decisions.
options: A Manager Who Leads a Team of One Hundred
A Young Manager Known for Careful Listening
Coworkers Who Say She Never Listens
Hannah Avoiding Any Planning Duties
quests.correctAnswer: A Young Manager Known for Careful Listening
quests.hint: Look at Hannah's new role and how her coworkers describe the way she leads.
quests.explanation: Hannah's responsibilities and her reputation for listening are two connected parts of this paragraph. Combining her role with her leadership style makes for the strongest summary.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The overnight bus to the mountains was fully booked during the holiday. Elena reserved her seat two weeks in advance to be safe. She arrived rested and ready to start hiking.
options: A Bus That Had Many Empty Seats
Elena Booking Her Seat the Night Before
Booking Early to Secure a Seat on a Busy Bus
Elena Arriving Tired from a Long Wait
quests.correctAnswer: Booking Early to Secure a Seat on a Busy Bus
quests.hint: Think about why Elena booked her seat early and how that choice affected her trip.
quests.explanation: Elena's early booking and her smooth, restful trip are cause and effect. Showing the link between planning ahead and the good outcome is exactly what the summary needs.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Three generations of the Patel family meet for breakfast at a small diner every other Saturday. Grandparents, parents, and grandchildren all squeeze into one big table. They have kept this tradition for over ten years.
options: A Ten-Year Family Breakfast Tradition
A Breakfast Held Only Once a Year
A Tradition That Started Last Month
Grandparents Who No Longer Join the Breakfast
quests.correctAnswer: A Ten-Year Family Breakfast Tradition
quests.hint: Picture who attends this gathering, how often it happens, and how long it has continued.
quests.explanation: Both the recurring gathering and its ten-year history matter here. Capturing the tradition's duration matters just as much as mentioning the breakfast itself.
